title: Data of compatible exact-equivalence derived squares
statement: Let B,Bprime,H,Hprime be abelian categories with chosen derived categories as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], E and G additive equivalences on B and H, L,Lprime and R,Rprime additive functors, and LF,LFprime,RF,RFprime supplied derived functors with comparison transformations epsilon,epsilonprime,eta,etaprime. Given ordinary comparison isomorphisms L then G isomorphic to E then Lprime and R then E isomorphic to G then Rprime, define the structure of compatible derived comparison data: derived equivalences F and GD; an isomorphism F to the derived equivalence induced by E; localization factorization isomorphisms for F and GD; left- and right-derived comparison isomorphisms; and their two factorization equations on every complex. These are data fields and equations, without an existence assertion or any choice of a witness.

source.place: current order 1316, Koszul-to-quotient comparison, including its unit equation

proof.text: Record the two derived equivalences, their localization factors, the two comparison isomorphisms and their evaluated factorization identities as fields of a structure.

proof_origin.place: Formal comparison and unit-normalization details of the recorded Koszul/quotient reconstruction; proved from the existing universal and reflector interfaces.

mathlib_searches.query: For sheaves of modules the unit of derived completion is the strict quotient cone followed by the universal derived inverse limit comparison; scalar preserving coefficient equivalences preserve Koszul completion and quotient towers
mathlib_searches.results: AdicCompletion.module; AdicCompletion; SheafOfModules.hasLimit; no matching sheaf-derived completion statement
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match. Ordinary completion and sheaf limits do not identify the specified derived units.

mathlib_searches.query: Equivalence of coefficient module categories preserves strict quotient towers and their derived completion units
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact match for the sheaf coefficient presentation or its derived unit.
Useful universal comparison API, but no concrete completed-sheaf unit comparison.

mathlib_searches.results: No sheaf completion-unit theorem in Mathlib. KanExtension.Basic supplies LeftExtension.isUniversalPrecompEquiv and RightExtension.isUniversalPrecompEquiv; Derived.LeftDerived/RightDerived supply uniqueness; Limits.Preserves.Limits supplies preservesLimitNatIso.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The generic Kan-extension APIs and preservation-of-limit comparisons are reused; the stated concrete compatibility results are absent.

from.place: last paragraph: the comparison with intrinsic completion, including the completion unit

lean.statement:
structure ExactEquivalenceDerivedSquareData
    {B B' H H' : Type*} [Category* B] [Category* B']
    [Category* H] [Category* H'] [Abelian B] [Abelian B']
    [Abelian H] [Abelian H'] [HasDerivedCategory B] [HasDerivedCategory B']
    [HasDerivedCategory H] [HasDerivedCategory H']
    (E : B ≌ B') (G : H ≌ H') [E.functor.Additive] [G.functor.Additive]
    (L : B ⥤ H) (L' : B' ⥤ H') [L.Additive] [L'.Additive]
    (R : H ⥤ B) (R' : H' ⥤ B') [R.Additive] [R'.Additive]
    (LF : DerivedCategory B ⥤ DerivedCategory H)
    (LF' : DerivedCategory B' ⥤ DerivedCategory H')
    (RF : DerivedCategory H ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    (RF' : DerivedCategory H' ⥤ DerivedCategory B')
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ LF ⟶
      L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (ε' : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ LF' ⟶
      L'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (η : R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ RF)
    (η' : R'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ RF')
    (eL : L ⋙ G.functor ≅ E.functor ⋙ L')
    (eR : R ⋙ E.functor ≅ G.functor ⋙ R')
